purpose: Prevent near-duplicate alpha experiments on frozen evidence and redirect research toward forward maturation, replacement value, and genuinely new PIT data or relation sources.

immediate_changes.summary: Block same-window threshold/top-N/scalar/lifecycle retunes in directions already rejected or frozen.
Move promising default-off paper sleeves toward closed forward outcomes, replacement value, concentration, kill-gates, and activation blockers.
Allow new alpha work only when it adds a new production-visible PIT field, a stronger relation graph, or exact same-day displacement value.

blocked_next_work: 5d PEAD or residual-leadership retry on the current watchlist
pre-event hold/exit lifecycle variant on the frozen windows
required_new_evidence: at least two independent earnings seasons of PIT estimate coverage
at least 20 usable candidates per season
pre-registered 10d hypothesis or materially richer expectation-quality field
next_allowed_work: PIT revenue estimate / analyst-count velocity field accumulation
forward replacement-value rows by expectation-quality bucket

blocked_next_work: score-weight tuning on the same frozen windows
component gates without monotonic non-OHLCV evidence
filled-trade-only rank attribution as promotion evidence
required_new_evidence: exact same-day displacement replacement value versus the core or paper candidate it would replace
new production-visible non-OHLCV component or regime/liquidity validity field
next_allowed_work: new PIT component coverage before any adapter or ranking rule

blocked_next_work: pocket-pivot/base/MA/volume-quality threshold scan on the frozen VCP sample
simple stop, pyramid, distribution-day, or loss-streak scalar on the same rows
required_new_evidence: nonzero production forward candidates and closed outcomes
forward replacement value, concentration, drawdown, and kill-gate evidence
new PIT intraday, 13F, or CAN SLIM fundamental coverage
next_allowed_work: candidate-feed readiness when forward candidate_count remains zero
forward lifecycle attribution with slot/heat/replacement accounting

blocked_next_work: same-ticker SEC filing recurrence or event-count promotion
simple pre-entry catalyst freshness or source/category diversity cut
semantic allocation or activation from a sleeve with zero forward candidates
required_new_evidence: stronger event relation source such as characteristic-similarity peers, source overlap, or theme propagation
SEC/news semantic direction with audited retrieval traces
nonzero forward rows and closed replacement-value outcomes
next_allowed_work: event graph with relation quality before event count

blocked_next_work: live activation based only on historical paper PnL
next_allowed_work: roll up paper-sleeve snapshots into activation blockers

blocked_next_work: same-family threshold/profile/notional/capital tweak with small paper-only improvement
